        continue-on-error: true

          exit-code: '0'
          ignore-unfixed: true
          vuln-type: 'os,library'

    name: Deploy

    needs: docker
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      # Deploy to Kubernetes cluster
      - name: Set up kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v1
        with:
          version: 'latest'
